0.composition_date_basis: The composition date of this commentary has not been established from the witnesses actually read for this batch. The retained Latin dedicatory preface at raw line 3 describes the earlier Luke exposition only in relative terms and provides no calendar year for the Mark exposition; the checked Mark 10:42-45 block likewise gives no composition year. On 2026-10-23 the primary CNRS/IRHT Bibale and FAMA catalogue pages could not be acquired directly (timeouts/HTTP 403); their indexed 725-730 estimate remains an unadopted lead, as recorded in artifact.cnrs-irht.bibale-bede-in-marci.2026-10-23-web.bibale-entry-39610. No author death, printing, retrieval or inferred calendar date is substituted. This is a bounded statement about the project's reviewed evidence, not a claim that scholarship knows no date for Bede's work.
